items.title: Risks of Downloading Suspicious Software and Unsafe Browsing Habits (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Risks of Downloading Suspicious Software and Unsafe Browsing Habits (PDF 124, printed 120).

blocks.text: Na-maloom websites se programs ya files download karne se computer ko nuqsan ho sakta hai ya aap ki maloomat chori ho sakti hai. Kuch downloads mein viruses ya spyware (chupke se jasoosi karne wala software) chhupe hote hain jo ijazat ke baghair data jama karte hain. Ghair-mehfooz browsing, jaise jaali (fake) websites par jana ya na-maloom links par click karna, bhi scams ya identity theft tak le ja sakti hai. Download se pehle source check karna aur izafi hifazat ke liye antivirus tools use karna zaroori hai. Mehfooz browsing ki aadatein devices aur data dono ko mehfooz rakhti hain.

blocks.prompt: Na-maloom website se free game download karne ke do khatre aur do bachao batayein.
blocks.explanation: Khatre: download mein virus ya spyware ho sakta hai jo ijazat ke baghair data jama kare; jaali website scam ya identity theft tak le ja sakti hai. Bachao: download se pehle source check karein (sirf bharosemand jagah se), aur antivirus tools use karein.

items: Na-maloom downloads mein viruses ya spyware ho sakte hain.
Fake websites aur na-maloom links se scams aur identity theft; source check karein aur antivirus rakhein.
